placements.title: owned intelligence, not rented access, is the asset a builder keeps
placements.frame: Does this expression treat intelligence/perspective as something owned and retained by the individual, versus a commoditized substrate merely rented or passed through?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 carry a single recurring thesis — owned vs. rented intelligence, with substrate cast as commodity and perspective as the kept asset — that the document itself (src-4) names as an 'individually-owned-intelligence thesis' expected to have prior positioning. Both EXISTING STRATA and EXISTING GRAPH STRUCTURE are empty for this repo, so there is no existing leaf or strata category to reuse, and nothing close enough to warrant an INSPIRED lineage edge. The grain test favors a leaf over a fact-placement: this names a subject (what counts as owned vs. rented intelligence, and which layer is the durable asset) that future envelopes plausibly keep feeding, not a one-time measurement or event. The position-pass's OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset grouping of exactly these two segments, and the aligned register/value/conviction reads (aphoristic maxim, autonomy/self-enhancement, principle-grade conviction) across both, support treating this as one coherent leaf rather than two. No shape in the (empty) existing structure makes any `under` legible, so this mint stands alone per the NEW branch of the three-check discipline.
